title: Lucy Brown, Artist
text:
Lucy Brown was born in a small town in Canada in 1950. Her father was a teacher and her mother was a nurse. Lucy loved to read books. She was a quiet girl.

When she was ten, Lucy started to paint. She painted pictures of trees and animals. Today she is a famous artist. She lives in Paris with her cat.

paragraph_translations: Lucy Brown nació en un pequeño pueblo de Canadá en 1950. Su padre era maestro y su madre era enfermera. A Lucy le encantaba leer libros. Era una niña tranquila.
Cuando tenía diez años, Lucy empezó a pintar. Pintaba cuadros de árboles y animales. Hoy es una artista famosa. Vive en París con su gato.
